recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.check: Raw versus standardized alpha on identically regenerated saved seeds.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.definition: Raw alpha uses item covariances; standardized alpha is J*rbar/(1+(J-1)*rbar), using off-diagonal item correlations. They are different estimands.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.bound: First replay the prespecified first seed in all19conditions as a generation-only pilot after CPUs release. If planned separately, replay the same2650seeds with paired raw/standardized metrics and a fixed600second cap. No new seed search or fitting.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.caution: Current files lack item covariance matrices, so standardized alpha cannot be recovered from score histograms or existing alpha summaries. Its direction/magnitude must be measured, not assumed to resolve the discrepancy.

recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.check: Chapter2 fixed versus redrawn item difficulty sensitivity.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.definition: Redrawn item banks mix between-bank and within-bank variability; a fixed bank conditions on a particular calibration.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.bound: Use a separately declared bank seed/design and independent response seeds; report all chosen banks and paired summaries. Do not choose a bank whose alpha/skew matches the source.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.caution: The original fixed bank, if any, is unavailable; this sensitivity cannot recover its exact descriptor.

recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.check: Moderator-probability assumption, mainly interpretive before further simulation.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.definition: For family Bernoulli(p) moderator and coefficient.7 with baseline variance1, its marginal variance contribution is.49*p*(1-p); explained fraction=.49*p*(1-p)/(1+.49*p*(1-p)).
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.result: The maximum atp=.5 is.1091314, consistent with the source approximately11percent. Thus p=.5 is substantively motivated, not an arbitrary knob; moving p away lowers this component.
recommended_bounded_checks_not_started.caution: Do not tune p to match alpha. An alternative probability requires independent source evidence or an explicitly labeled sensitivity; it cannot be presented as a recovered source choice.
